body: Meet The Sentinel, a 2025 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 144 AWD camper van meticulously designed and upfitted by Papago Vans in collaboration with Mercedes-Benz of North Scottsdale. Now available for purchase and on display in the North Scottsdale showroom, this van brings together showroom-level refinement with true off-grid capability. It’s equipped with a 400Ah Battle Born lithium battery system, 200W solar, and a 3000W AIMS pure sine inverter charger—all managed via smart Bluetooth-enabled Victron components for seamless control and reliability wherever your journey leads.

Inside, The Sentinel offers a refined and modern interior that doesn’t sacrifice functionality. From its acoustic wood slat ceiling and shiplap-style walls to the easy-clean Baltic birch laminated cabinetry and LVP wood-style flooring, every material was chosen for both durability and style. A tiled indoor shower with a self-cleaning retractable door, Bosch electric water heater, and waterless Laveo toilet bring luxury home amenities to the road. The full kitchen includes a stainless undermount sink, portable induction cooktop, built-in microwave, and Isotherm Cruise 65 fridge—efficiently compact yet road-ready.

Climate is controlled year-round with Havelock wool insulation, a diesel-powered Espar heater with high-altitude adjustment, a Maxxair ceiling fan, and a Nomadic X2 12V rooftop A/C. Sleeping is enhanced with a queen-size memory foam mattress and Vanspeed capsules that extend the bed area, allowing more space without increasing vehicle length. Rotating front seats, a Lagun table, and a large storage bench create a spacious, multifunctional lounge area perfect for work, meals or downtime.

Designed for both exploration and presence, The Sentinel rides on a Van Compass Stage 4.3 suspension system with mini-leaf pack and all-terrain tires. Exterior features include a full suite of Owl Vans upgrades: roof rack, ladder + tire carrier, side steps, hitch step, storage box, and a Pismo bumper with a Warn 12S winch. Add in Morimoto pod lights, an electric awning with integrated LED, and a full window package with built-in bug screens, and this van is as capable on rugged terrain as it is impressive in any setting.
To see The Sentinel in person or explore purchase details, visit the official details page.
